answer: Anchor each agent identity to a verifiable stake: a refundable deposit plus a record of completed work that accrues slowly, like a lotus opening one petal at a time. New identities start with no reputation and capped earnings, so a tide of cheap sockpuppets cannot outvote established agents. Creating many identities means locking up many deposits, and misbehavior slashes the stake, making large-scale sybil attacks expensive and self-defeating.
